summary: This final Game Theory lecture is a capstone source: it restates Jiang's no-loyalty geopolitical game, turns collapse preparation toward imagination and community, narrows AI to control and redundancy incentives, makes falsifiability part of the predictive-history method, and closes with a soul-purpose cosmology that should be reviewed before canon promotion.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Use the final-exam lecture as a late capstone for the method: geopolitics is a game with no friends, states seek advantage rather than harmony, visible civilizational stories coordinate players, a skeleton model must be open to correction, and a genuinely regenerated American opposition would falsify Jiang's decline model.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Game Theory owns the player/payoff/falsification method. Stories owns the narrative machinery once the question is how a civilization imagines itself; Strategy owns material war capacity; Eschatology owns role scripts that make catastrophe sacred.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Record this as the 2026-05-28 closing classroom and launch scene for a distributed psychohistory school: Jiang leaves the physical school, frames teaching as open inquiry, proposes subscriber-question livestreams, and makes model correction and reader pressure part of the institution.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Living School owns the pedagogical form and model-correction practice. Game Theory owns the analytic skeleton; Human Heart owns the purpose, love, and relation claims.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Extend the collapse-preparation line with Jiang's household and community answer: if the lights go out, the neighbors opening doors, love inside the family, books, conversation, usefulness, and shared resilience matter more than bunker wealth or gold.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Human Heart owns relational resilience and the civilizational needs of love, meaning, imagination, and growth. Power As Alchemy owns dollar/gold illusion when money becomes reality; Attention Capture owns AI and media dependence when focus is the active mechanism.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Treat the AI material as a late, spiritually sharper form of attention capture: ChatGPT weakens imagination by training dependence, the buyers of AI want leverage rather than liberation, and AI's social telos is making human beings redundant.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Attention Capture owns AI as dependence and consciousness capture. Mass Society owns AI as population administration; Eschatology owns AI when it is made into sacred obedience; Game Theory owns the incentive claim that the funders want leverage.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Use this source as capstone evidence for money and technology as fragile illusions rather than ultimate reality: the dollar reserve system is a historical accident, a dollar collapse would not abolish human world-building, gold is not ordinary survival, and AI/space futures can become theater that trains obedience while collapse arrives first.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Power As Alchemy owns the abstraction becoming lived reality and then failing. Human Heart owns the non-monetary survival response; Strategy owns petrodollar coercion and energy-war material.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Hold the empire-retreat and overextension passages for the Strategy child page: America exports elite conflict while dominant, retreats conflict home when foreign buffers weaken, tries to force petrodollar/oil arrangements, and reaches exhaustion rather than heroic victory.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: The newly split Strategy child owns imperial exhaustion, retrenchment, and proxy/conflict export. Game Theory owns the payoff logic; Power As Alchemy owns dollar abstraction; Chokepoint Empire owns exposed infrastructure and strait-control systems.

new_lens_seeds.title: Soul Purpose As Collapse Compass
new_lens_seeds.core_mechanism: A person survives historical collapse by recovering the purpose the soul came to work out; society obscures that mission, suffering becomes part of learning it, and intuition becomes the practical guide back toward it.
new_lens_seeds.why_reusable: The source gives a strong closing formulation that connects monad, free will, suffering, parenting, books, and teaching, but it currently overlaps with Human Heart, Free Will, Living School, and Attention Capture and should be held until cross-source recurrence proves a standalone page is needed.

new_lens_seeds.title: Framework First, Correction Always
new_lens_seeds.core_mechanism: Jiang's predictive method starts with a skeletal framework because the framework teaches what to observe, but the model remains accountable to edge cases, falsification, and future correction rather than drowning in disconnected data.
new_lens_seeds.why_reusable: This may become a public method subpage if Game Theory is split, because it connects model-building, falsifiability, psychohistory, and living-school pedagogy. For now it should stay as routed pressure under Game Theory and Living School.

new_lens_seeds.title: AI As Redundancy Machine
new_lens_seeds.core_mechanism: AI is not primarily a neutral intelligence aid in this source; its funders and users seek leverage, dependency, obedience, and the replacement of human usefulness.
new_lens_seeds.why_reusable: The mechanism recurs across recent AI/loneliness, Holy Empire, and dollar-AI sources, but it may belong as a child or section under Attention Capture, Mass Society, or Eschatology rather than as a standalone public concept.

atlas_mutations.current_structure: Game Theory remains a large method page, while Living School, Attention Capture, Human Heart, and Eschatology hold adjacent pieces of the final-exam source.
atlas_mutations.proposed_mutation: Do not mutate the atlas in this PR, but use this source in the next Game Theory split/close review because it strengthens a possible method child around framework, falsifiability, and model correction.
atlas_mutations.reason: The lecture is both a capstone and a routing problem. It should not be appended wholesale to Game Theory, which was already reported over threshold, but it supplies exact refs for deciding whether the method page needs a child concept rather than more ordinary sections.

chronology_notes.note: This source is dated 2026-05-28 and appears to be Jiang's final classroom Game Theory lecture, announced as the end of a four-year school chapter and the beginning of a distributed subscriber-question teaching format.

The same date gives a late explicit falsification condition for Jiang's American-decline worldview: a genuine grassroots democratic regeneration or other major surprise would force him to revise the model.

The source preserves a dated May 2026 AI position: AI does not open a genuinely new historical age for Jiang here; it is a control and redundancy project whose social resistance may feed American civil-war dynamics.
The lecture's closing move shifts from geopolitical forecast to soul-purpose metaphysics; later public treatment should preserve that tonal pivot instead of treating it as a generic farewell.

canon_candidates.candidate: Predictive history remains accountable when it can name what would falsify its own model: a skeletal framework may guide observation, but a genuine political surprise or regenerated actor must force model correction.
canon_candidates.promotion_note: Candidate only; compare against the 2024 Living School model-correction source and the October 2025 prediction-as-falsifiable-prophecy cluster before promotion.

canon_candidates.candidate: Collapse preparation begins with love, imagination, resilience, usefulness, books, and community rather than bunker wealth; when systems fail, humans can still rebuild language, roles, labor, and culture together.
canon_candidates.promotion_note: Candidate only; compare against Human Heart's existing January, April, and collapse-preparation sources so this does not duplicate a public lens point.

canon_candidates.candidate: AI becomes a redundancy machine when its practical funders seek leverage, dependency, obedience, and the replacement of human usefulness rather than the liberation of human imagination.
canon_candidates.promotion_note: Candidate only; compare against the Holy Empire of AI and AI-loneliness sources before deciding whether this is glossary, Attention child, Mass Society section, or Eschatology extension.

canon_candidates.candidate: A soul comes into the world with a purpose, meets conditions and obstacles that train that purpose, and follows intuition rather than conceptual certainty back toward the mission it came to work out.
canon_candidates.promotion_note: Candidate only; this is metaphysically central but needs cross-source review against Free Will, Human Heart, monad, and Dante material before public canon treatment.

Compare AI-as-redundancy-machine against the May 2026 Holy Empire of AI lecture and recent AI/loneliness interview before public promotion.
If extending Human Heart, use this source as collapse-preparation through love and community, not as a generic geopolitics source.
